Chapter 1144: 11: Winning Over (Request For Subscription)_2

Chapter 1144: Chapter 11: Winning Over (Request for Subscription)_2

But Chaos Venerables? Currently, there are already over a hundred. With a hundred Chaos Venerables fighting over the ‘soup’ discarded by the Great Saints, one can only imagine how fierce the struggle will be.

“What do you want to say?” Lin Yuan looked at Divine Wind Venerable.

“I want to invite you to join us.” Divine Wind Venerable said, “We Chaos Venerables need to join forces to have an advantage in our struggle against other venerables.”

“Rest assured, we already have twelve Chaos Venerables, including four peak venerables. If you join us, you will surely gain something from this venture.”

Divine Wind Venerable continued, “Of course, after you join, all gains from exploring this Postnatal Universe will be managed by me and distributed after the exploration is complete.”

“Trust me, only in this way can we maximize our gains, which is beneficial for you and has no disadvantages.”

Lin Yuan looked at Divine Wind Venerable, shook his head, and said, “Hand over all the gains to you for distribution?”

Although it was impossible for him to choose to join, Lin Yuan was still a bit helpless. Were they treating him as a free hired hand?

Who knows how Divine Wind Venerable would distribute?

“I’m not interested.” Lin Yuan said directly.

“Not interested?” Divine Wind Venerable was slightly taken aback. Before coming, he had already met with other venerables, and they all agreed with his view.

With over a hundred Chaos Venerables gathered, if some venerables could unite, they would indeed have a great advantage.

Even among Chaos Venerables, the gap is not that large, far less than the chasm between Great Saints and venerables.

At this time, numerical superiority was very important.

“Consider it again…” Divine Wind Venerable continued.

“I said, not interested.” Lin Yuan frowned.

“Alright, the choice is yours.” Divine Wind Venerable was silent for a while and did not continue to persuade him, “But let me remind you, going solo will put you at a disadvantage.”

After speaking, Divine Wind Venerable turned and left.

…

“Divine Wind, you were actually rejected?”

A peak venerable next to Divine Wind Venerable sneered, “Which Void Domain is this venerable from? Haven’t they even heard of your reputation, Divine Wind?”

“Regardless of his background, with a great enemy before us, he doesn’t think of joining forces but instead plans to go solo? How shortsighted!”

Divine Wind Venerable shook his head, and in an icy tone said, “Once this Postnatal Universe is fully opened, and many venerables rush in, he will know what a mistake it was to reject me.”

“Indeed, does he really think of himself as a Great Saint?”

Another peak venerable also spoke, feeling that Lin Yuan would regret it sooner or later.

Being personally invited by peak venerables—what an honor. Lin Yuan refused without even considering it?

If it weren’t for the imminent opening of the Xuanhuang Universe, and the presence of too many nearby venerables, the two peak venerables would have planned to teach Lin Yuan a lesson.

“Let’s go, invite the next one.”

Divine Wind Venerable continued to fly forward. With every venerable they invited to join, their strength would increase, giving them a greater advantage in the upcoming struggle.

…

In the depths of many layers of space-time, the Dual Origin Great Saint, with dual horns, gazed into one corner of the universe.

“The Altar Spirit said this Postnatal Universe was created by the Xuanhuang Great Saint, and the Xuanhuang Great Saint, is the Great Saint closest to becoming Invincible Great Saint?”

The Dual Origin Great Saint thought to himself, and it was precisely because of this information that he was willing to endure the cost of being fleeced by the Altar Spirit to force his way here.

“To earn such an evaluation from the Altar Spirit, the strength of the Xuanhuang Great Saint must be terrifying, likely surpassing all other unparalleled Great Saints of that era.”

“The Postnatal Universe he left behind is worth my full effort to compete for.”

The Dual Origin Great Saint’s eyes shimmered with anticipation.

The existence of the Altar Spirit is similar to the Eye of Myriad Laws, both related to thirteenth-order time life. The Dual Origin Great Saint also happened to enter the space of the Altar Spirit by chance.

Without sufficient luck, even a peerless Great Saint could not contact the Altar Spirit.

“The ones to watch out for this time are Wild Barbarian, Tian Lu, and Black Light, but as for the other five…” The Dual Origin Great Saint cast a glance at the Nine Phoenix Great Saint, Shadow Demon Great Saint, and five other Great Saints.

There was no excessive attention given.

Among the nine Great Saints present, there were clearly three tiers.

The first tier was the Dual Origin Great Saint, Wild Barbarian Great Saint, and Black Light Great Saint.

These three Great Saints were the strongest, especially the Dual Origin Great Saint, whose path had a great chance of becoming a peerless Great Saint.

For a Chaos Great Saint to become a peerless Great Saint mainly depended on the path they chose.

If the path was unsuitable, a Chaos Great Saint was destined never to become a peerless Great Saint.

In essence, regarding the thirteenth step, the gap between a Chaos Great Saint and a peerless Great Saint was not that large, mainly because the exploration and understanding of the thirteenth step by a peerless Great Saint were undoubtedly superior to those of a Chaos Great Saint.

…

The second tier was Tian Lu Great Saint and two other Chaos Great Saints.

And the third tier was Shadow Demon Great Saint, Nine Phoenix Great Saint, and three other newly minted Chaos Great Saints.

…

“What brings the Dual Origin Guy here?”

The towering Wild Barbarian Great Saint glanced at the Dual Origin Great Saint, feeling a slight headache.

Thousands of years ago, he had heard that the Dual Origin Great Saint was exploring a site far away from here, so distant that even a Chaos Great Saint would take millions of years to get here.

“I arrived through the Eye of Myriad Laws within a short time, so how did Dual Origin manage it? Was it also the Eye of Myriad Laws?”

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint pondered to himself, having crossed paths with the Dual Origin Great Saint multiple times. The other’s strength was indeed terrifying, and even he could only manage to maintain a standoff.

He even felt that the Dual Origin Great Saint had not used all his trump cards then.

“No matter, whoever dares to block me this time, I’ll just crush them.”

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint’s aura surged, tearing apart the surrounding space-time.

To arrive here, he paid three billion chaos stones to the Eye of Myriad Laws. If he couldn’t recoup this cost, he would suffer a heavy loss.

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint couldn’t accept such an outcome. As a Chaos Great Saint, and one who was good at offense among the Chaos Great Saints, when had he ever suffered such a loss?

…

“In terms of strength, I’m not as good as Dual Origin, Wild Barbarian, and Black Light,” Tian Lu Great Saint silently observed his surroundings, clearly aware of his tier level.

“But in the fight for treasures, it’s not just about strength,” Tian Lu Great Saint thought to himself.

Each Chaos Great Saint, according to their evolved chaos power path, has different specialties. Dual Origin, Wild Barbarian, and Black Light were notably adept at offense.

But Tian Lu Great Saint excelled at survival.

“As long as I seize the opportunity and get the treasures, even Dual Origin and the others won’t be able to deal with me.”

Tian Lu Great Saint had no intention of going head-to-head with the three Great Saints. That would clearly be a case of using his weakness against others’ strength.

“However, this Postnatal Universe actually managed to attract Dual Origin over…”

Tian Lu Great Saint’s thoughts spread as he roughly gauged the position of Dual Origin Great Saint, incredibly far from here.

Currently exploring an ancient site.

Yet even so, the Dual Origin Great Saint still rushed over.

Clearly, the Dual Origin Great Saint paid a huge price.

Abandoning the site he was exploring and paying a high price to arrive here could only mean one thing.

That is, the creator of this Postnatal Universe was extraordinary, or there was something inside that the Dual Origin Great Saint desperately needed.

…

“Nine Chaos Great Saints?”

Lin Yuan was also observing the nine Chaos Great Saints.

“Dual Origin Great Saint?” Lin Yuan looked distantly at the horn-headed Great Saint.

The chaotic path evolved by the Dual Origin Great Saint was the fusion of two forces, although not as perfect as Lin Yuan’s fusion of Taiyin Taiyin.

And able to form a new power like Taiji, but it was not to be underestimated.

It’s known that an ordinary Chaos Great Saint, even if wanting to evolve two chaotic paths, can’t achieve full fusion, demanding a lot from the Great Saint themselves.

However, once the fusion succeeds, the increase in combat power would be unprecedented.

Lin Yuan’s evolution into Taiyin Taiyang Taiji, finally forming the Chaotic Taiji Dao, could presumably reach the level of a peerless Great Saint directly.
